init.title: WhiskyDB settings
init.description: Update the API key or AI endpoint.

data_description.ai_api_key: Create a new key on console.mistral.ai. Leave empty for manual entry only.
data_description.ai_base_url: Default: https://api.mistral.ai/v1 (Mistral). For local models e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama).

error.invalid_key: Invalid format — the API key must not contain spaces and must be at least 20 characters long

add_rack.name: Add rack
add_rack.description: Adds a storage rack within a collection.

cellar_id.description: ID of the collection (optional, defaults to the first)

remove_rack.name: Delete rack
remove_rack.description: Deletes a rack. Bottles in it lose their storage location but stay in the collection.

add_cellar.name: Add collection
add_cellar.description: Creates a new, empty collection (cabinet) in the instance.

rename_cellar.name: Rename collection
rename_cellar.description: Renames a collection (the first one if cellar_id is omitted).

remove_cellar.name: Delete collection
remove_cellar.description: Deletes an empty collection (rejected if it contains racks or is the last one).

add_whisky.name: Add whisky
add_whisky.description: Adds a whisky record to the collection, optionally with its first storage slot.

rack_id.description: ID of the target rack (optional — without a rack, `quantity` bottles are created without a storage location)

slot.description: Slot number in the rack (only if rack_id is given)

quantity.description: Number of bottles to create when rack_id is omitted (default 1)

initial_status.description: Initial status of the created bottles: sealed, opened or finished (default sealed)

bottler.description: Independent bottler (if different from the distillery)

whisky_type.description: Type: Single Malt, Blended Malt, Blended Whisky, Single Grain, Bourbon, Rye, Tennessee Whiskey, Corn Whiskey, Irish Single Malt, Irish Pot Still, Japanese Whisky, World Whisky, Other

cask_type.description: Cask type (e.g. First Fill Bourbon, Oloroso, PX …)

storage_location.description: Free-text storage location (in addition to the rack slot)

update_whisky.name: Edit whisky
update_whisky.description: Edits the information of an existing whisky record (same fields as add_whisky, without storage slot).

remove_whisky.name: Remove whisky
remove_whisky.description: Removes a whisky record and ALL of its bottles from the collection.

add_slot.name: Add bottle
add_slot.description: Adds another physical bottle to an existing whisky.

update_slot.name: Edit bottle
update_slot.description: Changes format or comment of a physical bottle.

slot_idx.description: Index of the bottle in the list of storage slots

move_slot.name: Move bottle
move_slot.description: Moves a physical bottle to another rack / slot.

slot_idx.description: Index of the bottle to move

remove_slot.name: Remove bottle
remove_slot.description: Removes ONE bottle without changing its status (not a consumption service — use open_bottle/finish_bottle for that). The whisky is deleted along with it automatically if this was its last bottle.

slot_idx.description: Index of the bottle to remove

open_bottle.name: Open bottle
open_bottle.description: Marks a bottle as opened (sealed → opened). Fires the whiskydb_bottle_opened event.

finish_bottle.name: Finish bottle
finish_bottle.description: Marks a bottle as finished (opened → finished). The storage slot is NOT deleted: the record stays viewable with its history. Fires the whiskydb_bottle_finished event.

update_remaining.name: Update fill level
update_remaining.description: Updates the fill level (%) of an OPENED bottle (manual tracking, e.g. weighing or visual estimation). Fires the whiskydb_bottle_low event ONLY when the threshold is crossed for the first time (not on every call) and can be used directly as an automation trigger.

add_tasting.name: Add tasting (outside the collection)
add_tasting.description: Adds an entry to the tasting diary for a whisky you only TASTED (at friends', in a bar, at a tasting) without ever owning a bottle. Has NO effect on the collection (whiskies, racks, sensors): these entries live in a separate list and appear in the card's "🥂" tab together with the finished bottles. Fires the whiskydb_tasting_added event.

whisky_type.description: Type: Single Malt, Blended Malt, Blended Whisky, Single Grain, Bourbon, Rye, Tennessee Whiskey, Corn Whiskey, Irish Single Malt, Irish Pot Still, Japanese Whisky, World Whisky, Other

place.description: Place of tasting (e.g. "At Marc's", "Le Malt bar")

remove_tasting.name: Delete tasting (outside the collection)
remove_tasting.description: Deletes an entry from the tasting diary.
